scopeClarification.authority: PLAN.md15-17 + UI_01_2_BASELINE_GATE_R4.md1/4; coordinator request for explicit research-vs-regression mapping
scopeClarification.historicalInventoryMeaning: 716 original role/state discovery records retained byte-semantically as inventory history. requiredRecords/outcomes in snapshot are historical, not active-stage full behavior test count. This clarification defines active visual obligations without claiming any is closed.
scopeClarification.baselineMeaning: All1080 baseline own tuples retained. Role/session bridges and route gates remain own per receiver. Shared identical visual template/handler witnesses can reduce repeat capture geometry after explicit source/computed-style/bitmap signoff.
scopeClarification.visualMeaning: Appearance of pending/error/empty/long/open dialog and genuine focus. One visual invalid/success/error example per truly distinct message template, not all business validators or each endpoint transaction.
scopeClarification.deferredMeaning: Full financial lifecycle, authorization/tenant isolation, persistence/readback, exhaustive domain validation and each handler behavior belongs to UI09.1 regression backlog, with no PASS assigned.
scopeClarification.crossRoleReuseLimit: May share identical primitive geometry/appearance and focus handler among allowed/read contexts only after explicit comparison and receiver own baseline bridge. This does not accept recipient behavior or permission. Different visibility/labels/layout/CSS/handler appearance demands a separate visual variant.
scopeClarification.mergeLimit: Groups joining different source handlers cover only common visual primitive appearance. Their distinct API behavior is deferred; composite layout differences remain own baseline and long visual witnesses. Grouping is a proposal, not approved component equivalence.
scopeClarification.bindingScope: 1080 baseline obligations plus visualObligationGroups below. The716 historical rows are not binding as per-role full behavior scenarios for UI01.2.
